title: Manifold-Aware Perturbations for Constrained Generative Modeling
abstract: arXiv:2601.23151v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Generative models have enjoyed widespread success in a variety of applications. However, they encounter inherent mathematical limitations in modeling distributions where samples are constrained by equalities, as is frequently the setting in scientific domains. In this work, we develop a computationally cheap, mathematically justified, and highly flexible distributional modification for combating known pitfalls in equality-constrained generative models. We propose perturbing the data distribution in a constraint-aware way such that the new distribution has support matching the ambient space dimension while still implicitly incorporating underlying manifold geometry. Through theoretical analyses and empirical evidence on several representative tasks, we illustrate that our approach consistently enables data distribution recovery and stable sampling with both diffusion models and normalizing flows.

translated_title: 面向约束生成建模的流形感知扰动方法
translated_abstract: 生成模型在各类应用中已取得广泛成功。然而，在建模样本受等式约束的分布时，它们会遇到固有的数学限制，而这种情形在科学领域中十分常见。在本工作中，我们开发了一种计算成本低、数学上有依据且高度灵活的分布修正方法，用于应对等式约束生成模型中的已知缺陷。我们提出以约束感知的方式对数据分布进行扰动，使得新分布的支撑集与周围空间维度相匹配，同时仍然隐式地保留了底层流形的几何结构。通过理论分析以及在多个代表性任务上的实证结果，我们证明了该方法能够在扩散模型和归一化流中一致地实现数据分布恢复与稳定采样。
tldr: 该论文提出一种约束感知的流形感知扰动方法，通过低成本地修正数据分布使其支撑集匹配周围空间维度并隐式保留流形几何，克服了等式约束生成模型的数学局限，实现扩散模型和归一化流的稳定采样与分布恢复。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a constraint-aware, manifold-aware perturbation method that cheaply modifies the data distribution to have full ambient-space support while implicitly preserving manifold geometry, overcoming the mathematical limitations of equality-constrained generative models and enabling consistent distribution recovery and stable sampling with both diffusion models and normalizing flows.
